# Spring Framework source evidence fixtures

Unmodified files from Spring Framework commit
`82a6b40b9366ec181ededdad282b307ee5381a52` (7.0.9):

- `spring-webmvc/src/main/java/org/springframework/web/servlet/mvc/Controller.java`
- `spring-webmvc/src/main/java/org/springframework/web/servlet/mvc/AbstractController.java`
- Root `LICENSE.txt` and `framework-docs/src/docs/dist/notice.txt`.

Upstream: https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/tree/82a6b40b9366ec181ededdad282b307ee5381a52

The two Java files retain their original copyright/license headers. The notice
template is preserved verbatim, including upstream build placeholders. Fixtures
are source evidence for a dangling `Controller.html#config` reference; they are
not compiled or executed by these tests.
